title: Puce gloves.
html_source:
The desire for “puce gloves” reflects the vision of Irish artists adopting snotgreen as a new art color. The gloves may also be used as symbols of the death-mother whose deteriorating liver had caused her to vomit “green sluggish bile.”
Mulligan can be viewed as an arbiter of the death-mother.
